title: 14mm Kannastor Press
description:
Kannastors 14mm Botanical Press is of a very high quality with ultra smooth threads and 3 spacers in 2 different sizes.
When it comes to these little presses it is safe to say they are not made equal. There are heaps of these on the market and what you can usually expect from most cheaper versions is a very ordinary rough thread and likely only 2 spacers the same size. Having a smooth thread like those on a kannastor is a huge advantage both in usability and performance.
High Quality 61/60 Anodised Aluminium (food grade)
Kannastor have chosen well with their choice of alloy. Using a good quality alloy is essential in making a product that is actually going to last and also be safe to use with your favourite botanicals. There is no risk when using heat on these little presses.
Included
1 x Kannastor 14mm Press
1 x Carry Bag
